description: This file defines the LoggerAppenderPhp class, a custom appender for the log4php logging library. It logs events by triggering PHP errors categorized by log level, using a specific layout (LoggerLayoutTTCC). The class extends LoggerAppenderSkeleton and implements methods to initialize, append log events, and close the appender.

classes.name: LoggerAppenderPhp
classes.description: A PHP logging appender that sends log events using trigger_error(), mapping log levels to PHP error types, and formatting messages with LoggerLayoutTTCC.

methods.name: LoggerAppenderPhp
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the appender with a given name.

methods.name: activateOptions
methods.description: Initializes the layout to LoggerLayoutTTCC and marks the appender as open.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Sets the appender state to closed.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Logs an event by formatting it with the layout and triggering a PHP error with a severity based on the log level.
